name: Lehi
line: Lehi was a town in Judah where Samson, helped by the Spirit of the LORD, defeated the Philistines, and where God gave him water when he was thirsty.

moments.title: Philistines gather near Lehi
moments.text: The Philistines went up, camped in Judah, and deployed themselves near the town of Lehi. They came to arrest Samson.

moments.title: Samson breaks free
moments.text: When Samson arrived in Lehi, the Philistines came out shouting, and the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him. The ropes broke loose from his hands, and with a fresh donkey's jawbone he struck down a thousand men.

moments.title: Water from the hollow place
moments.text: Samson was very thirsty and cried out to the LORD. God opened up the hollow place in Lehi, and when Samson drank, his strength returned.
